note: Per-curve B-splines. Rebuild each as splinepy.BSpline(degrees=[degree], knot_vectors=[knot_vector], control_points=control_points) then pass to BeamMe create_beam_mesh_from_splinepy (or create_beam_mesh_parametric_curve via the spline evaluator). control_points are (n_ctrl, 3) xyz in mm. knot_vector=null marks a degree-1 polyline fallback.
